text:
The independent JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 map classified **98% of the 81.3-hectare loss area as forest before the reported 2021 loss**. A later year was also observed in the Hansen series, satisfying the tool’s corroboration rule.

Uruguay’s 2021 MGAP forest map provides additional context: it mapped 68.1 hectares of the event area as planted pine forest, none as native forest, and 13.2 hectares outside mapped forest.

These independent maps support the presence and type of forest in the area; they do not independently establish the timing or cause of the loss.
